title: Reliable ContextVM terminal result delivery
observed_behavior: ContextVM terminal responses are ephemeral relay events, so a handler can complete while the client misses the first response publication.
intended_behavior: Signer-first operator commands establish a reply subscription before publish, wait a bounded time, and retry the same idempotent logical request so Bahia can replay a cached terminal response without re-executing the handler.
scope: deployments preview, deploy, and route-attach result delivery
local, public, and partial dual-relay topologies

delivery_contract.terminal_truth: ContextVM result is an acknowledgment; durable workflow truth remains in canonical observables
